name: S3b RR-4.1
text: Deciding to do it. How will you coax yourself to do this? Make it spacious? Make it warm and held? Something else? Preview what you are going to do: will you close your eyes? Will you come out and go back in again? What will you do at the end? If you are going to use a recording, read the script if you can. Remind yourself that if you say ‘stop’ at any time, the induction will end. If you say ‘less’, you will be asked to do less. If you say ‘quiet’, the talking will stop. You can also just open your eyes and stop, and then come all the way back anyway. You don’t need to ask any parts for permission to stop, even if a part tells you that you do.
